intro.text: Lord Merchant Vey's secretary at the Guild.

items.text: Unimpressed by Kenton's rank, Grelin brushed him off when he came to see Vey before the final vote, until Kenton's loud bluff about Vey's secret got him invited in.

appearance.text: Shoulder-length blond hair and a blond goatee; he dresses in a purple shirt under a white jacket, topped by a white top hat banded in purple.
